name: Raid Window
author: SCUMSA
description: Stops defenders ending a raid by logging out. While a base is taking real raid damage, its offline protection is kept from switching on mid-raid. Works with offline and flag-specific protection, changes no server setting, touches only the base under attack, and stops once the base is quiet.

needs.why: Tells the plugin when a base is taking real raid damage, with decay, upgrades and admin clearing already left out. Without it the plugin never knows a raid is going on, and nothing is pushed.

Reads a base's protection and pushes its start back. On offline raid protection the write is 'Postpone offline protection', which only ever moves the start later. On flag-specific raid protection it is 'Set a flag's protection window', which cannot be undone. The tab names the one your server uses.
